These are corroborating sources found afterwards, not the material the ranges were originally set from. A row with sources can be checked by anyone: open the page and compare. 'consistent': figures for the same work and unit fall within or match the range. 'partly': the figures overlap the range only in part, or are for a related or partial scope (another size, depth or tier, equipment without installation, or parts the note adds up); the note says which, and a partly row is not evidence that the range is right. 'inconsistent': figures for the same work and unit do not overlap the range. 'none': no comparable public figure was found, which is not a finding that the range is wrong.
